I went outside and it was a beautiful day and not a single tree was blowing. Another day it was down pouring. I’m in my house listening to all the rain pounding on my roof. I happened to launch the app to see what it would say, and everything was green and said, “Good To Fly”. I think it’s time to find a new app. And to think I was actually considering to pay for a subscription to this.

This app shows me exactly what I need to know for my flight planning purposes, and it does so with a really efficient and easy to read grid of information. Pros: > I can change thresholds for any of the weather or atmospheric metrics > I can send a snapshot of the weather/forecast to myself to add to my flight log later > The app is updated regularly. If you’re looking for sUAS apps (or any apps for that matter), check out the last time they were updated! > I bought the subscription and I think having several days’ worth of data is worth the small price - helps a lot for planning flights for later in the week. Cons: > Not a con, but a feature request. Please consider adding a way to store a few favorite locations. I currently save GPS coordinates in a notepad page and paste them into search when trying to plan a flight, but favorites would be a little easier. Overall excellent app for uav weather as long as they keep doing a great job keeping the app up to date and simple to use.

title: Use daily ...question
body: I love this app I have a suggestion if you could please add under the no fly zone settings if we are within the colored circle of certain airports or helo pads can you place that colored dot on the map where the airport is so we can see where's it at, not just the large circle range. This can help us adjust our location easier or be aware of what direction to be alerted. Thanks

title: Great app and support
body: Great app where you can set your limits and it will quickly inform you if you are outside those limits. But like any other weather report it is not all accurate. The support for this app is awesome, I emailed with an issue and shortly after I received a response with a fix.

title: Wonderful
body: This app is really great. With one tap, you are displayed with the local conditions you care about before you fly. It is presented in an easy to understand, unobscured format that will let you know within seconds if you’re good to fly. The app is simple, clean, accurate and easy to use. It provides the average enthusiast with everything they need to check before flying all in one convenient space. Not to mention, it’s customizable to fit your needs or the restrictions of your UAV. Can’t recommend this app enough. It’s just what I was looking for. I will continue to recommend this to all UAV users.

body: Updates every hour with weather and no flying zones, even temporary no flying zones, and with it the explanation why you can't fly there. This is THE best app if you are an owner of a UAV/Drone/quadcopter. With this app you always know when and where to fly!! Must have!

title: Best of all the UAV apps I've seen

body: I've been searching for drone apps and never saw this one until typing uav. This has everything I was looking for and more! I was looking for a winds aloft app, this allows the altitude to be entered and it calculates Hourly wind estimates. I love the hourly GPS and solar storm prediction as well. I have mainly been using foreflight for winds aloft and TRFs. I combine this with the app "zone" to see where small helipads are as well. I'll buy a subscription to keep up the good work! Not all airports need a 5 mile radius.

I used and relied heavily on the web based version. Told many of my RC friends about it. Always found it to be very reliable and accurate and planned what days I'd be flying based on it. Very excited about the app version. Even better!
